EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
COUNCILMEMBER DISCH

Councilmember Disch spoke about the Ward 1 coffee hour and the conversation regarding the proposed Comp Plan. 

She also provided an update about the upcoming A2Zero Week, encouraging the community to participate. 

Councilmember Disch spoke about a NY Times article highlighting the Argus Farm Stop.


COUNCILMEMBER HARRISON

Councilmember Harrison thanked Chief Anderson for updating the AAPD policy regarding preemptive traffic stops, noting the new policy is in align with Council policy.


COUNCILMEMBER EYER

Councilmember Eyer provided an update on the proposed Comprehensive Plan and spoke about the need to eliminate exclusionary zoning.


COUNCILMEMBER AKMON

Councilmember Akmon provided an update regarding discounts on electric lawn equipment for City residents. Councilmember Akmon provided a clarification regarding some of the paused bike lane projects due to funding questions.


COUNCILMEMBER CORNELL

Councilmember Cornell thanked the Police and Fire Departments for their shared open houses, stating they were a big success for the community and families. 

Councilmember Cornell provided an update on Taste of Ann Arbor coming up the first weekend in June.


COUNCILMEMBER WATSON

Councilmember Watson provided an update on the County's listening session regarding a senior millage.
